compactSheets.prompt:
Create a cohesive PAINTED FACETED DARK FANTASY sprite and portrait asset sheet matching references. EXACTLY 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equal cells, high resolution. ONE character outfit in all cells. Generous 12 percent gutters so NO figure, weapon, halo, hat, robe or effects crosses a cell boundary.
IMPORTANT split between use cases: the FIRST SEVEN cells are COMBAT and MUST all face SCREEN RIGHT in a clear SIDE THREE-QUARTER profile. Nose/helmet/hood opening aims right; torso, knees and toes visibly aim to right. Idle and guard are right-facing too. No front-facing combat poses. Last TWO cells are menu art and may face the viewer.
Cells in reading order: 1 right-facing combat ready idle; 2 right-facing defensive guard; 3 attack/cast anticipation; 4 attack/cast extension; 5 attack/cast contact; 6 follow-through and recover; 7 small hit recoil while head STILL faces RIGHT; 8 front-facing full-body character-menu presentation; 9 LARGE matching head-and-shoulders close-up portrait with full hood/hat/helmet/halo visible and comfortable headroom.
Keep exact same body proportions, head size, armor details, weapon design, cloth layers and palette in all combat frames. Fixed camera, same pixel scale, shared feet ground line, dynamic crouches are allowed without shrinking. Combat weapon and magic aim RIGHT. Four attack cells depict a coherent class-specific sequence. Preserve approved pose silhouettes from reference when provided. This is production game art in painted faceted motif, NOT blocky 3D or wireframe. Genuine transparent background, no drawn checkerboard, no floor shadows, text, borders, scenery or UI. Menu pose and portrait must exactly match combat armor. Let armor materials be rich and readable.

reaverFacingCorrection.prompt: Create an exact FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS game combat sprite correction sheet, eight cells. References 1 to 4 define the armor of columns 1 to 4 respectively: base black steel burgundy cape; Ashen Vigil black ragged cape; Gilded Oathsworn gold burgundy cape; Warden Mail blue steel navy cape. ONLY one full-body figure per cell, generous gutters, no portraits. TOP ROW all four knights in the same sword-ready guard pose: TRUE RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, right-facing helmet visor/nose pointing horizontally right, shoulders and chest viewed from the LEFT SIDE rather than front, feet pointing screen right. Two hands hold their greatsword diagonally forward up toward screen right, ready to fight an opponent to the RIGHT. BOTTOM ROW each same knight in a small backward recoil after being struck from the RIGHT: torso leans LEFT, helmet visor CONTINUES LOOKING RIGHT, feet grounded, sword retained in both hands. Important: actual combat side profile facing RIGHT in ALL EIGHT cells. Never look at viewer, never face left, never turn back. Same proportions, head size, armor details, camera, scale and per-cell baseline. Complete boots, sword and cape inside cell with clear empty margins. Painted faceted dark fantasy matching supplied art motif. Transparent background, no checkerboard, floor shadow, text, frames or effects.
